exceptions.rationale: Potential denial of service through glob pattern amplification (globparts). The affected minimatch 9.0.9 is installed only through @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, part of the lint toolchain (typescript-eslint, @typescript-eslint/parser, eslint-config-next), all dev dependencies, and never runs in the deployed application; the only patterns it receives come from the repository configuration. Only minimatch 11.0.1 and later fix it, a major version typescript-estree does not accept. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-31 for 30 days; an agent may renew it for 30 days after a re-review while every path stays in the lint toolchain (a path into the deployed application needs the owner). Remove it as soon as typescript-eslint accepts a fixed minimatch.
evidence: bun audit on 2026-11-05: the advisory now covers >=7.0.0 <11.0.1, so minimatch 3.1.5 is no longer affected and its exception was removed.
npm registry on 2026-10-31: minimatch 11.0.3 is the latest; @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.47.0 requires ^9.0.4.

bun pm why minimatch@9.0.9 on 2026-11-05: it comes through @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.47.0 (typescript-eslint, @typescript-eslint/parser, eslint-config-next 16.3.6), and every path ends in a dev dependency.

Re-reviewed on 2026-11-07 for a patched @supabase/ssr 0.7.0 (werk-flow/werkflow-planning#232): bun pm why minimatch@9.0.9 still shows only @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.47.0, every path ending in a dev dependency.
